summary: Independent QA reviewed project-archive.ts and project-archive.test.ts. Parser-level acceptance is demonstrated for generated project and legacy ZIP fixtures; application-level restoration is not accepted.
nextAction: Wire the loader into the UI and apply every returned project domain, then add browser and end-to-end restore evidence before re-audit.
blockers: No UI action invokes loadProjectArchive or accepts .lsp-project files; LoadScene.svelte still exposes only .spk input.
The payload is not applied to sceneStore, componentStore/hub, Blockly workspace, participant settings, map/model library, calibration state, or selected season state.
project.capabilities.seasonRestore is hard-coded false, so season identity cannot be restored or protected during load/switch.
No reactive dirty-state integration or unsaved-change prompt protects the current project during load.
Browser, keyboard, responsive, screen-reader, Firefox/Chromium, and participant evidence is absent.

milestones.evidence: Reviewed src/lib/spike/project-archive.ts: project/legacy dispatch, required and optional entries, nested metadata checks, safe model names, scene consistency, robot validation, Blockly validation, and calibration loading.
npm test -- --run src/lib/spike/project-archive.test.ts src/lib/spike/project-contract.test.ts: 2 files and 10 tests passed.
Independent QA decision recorded: archive parser accepted for covered fixtures; UI restoration and end-to-end round trip remain blocked by the listed gaps.
